,'Mock Part 3','Full review']:
    ['B1 baseline','Present perfect','Past narrative','Future forms','Modals','Core vocabulary','Checkpoint 1','Reading for gist','Reading for detail','Linking words','Paragraph building','Email writing','Speaking extension','Checkpoint 2','Conditionals','Passive voice','Reported speech','Phrasal verbs','Collocations','Pronunciation','Checkpoint 3','B2 reading','Opinion writing','Discussion skills','Precision vocabulary','Error correction','Integrated task','Checkpoint 4','B2 challenge','Progress review'];
  root.innerHTML=crumbs([['Memberships','members'],[TIER[state.tier].name,'member'],['Learning Pathways','section'],[p[0],'section']])+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><div><strong>${p[0]}</strong><br><small>${p[1]}</small></div><button class="rjx-btn" id="pathBack">← All pathways</button></div><div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>30-day programme</h2><p>Open each day, complete the task and continue through the full programme.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-list">${focuses.map((x,i)=>`<button class="rjx-row" data-path-day="${i}" style="width:100%;text-align:left;border:0"><div><strong>Day ${i+1} · ${x}</strong><small>${(i+1)%7===0?'Checkpoint: review the week and record what improved.':'Short lesson, active practice and one production task.'}</small></div><span class="rjx-chip">Open →</span></button>`).join('')}</div><div id="pathWork" style="margin-top:16px"></div>`;
  wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('pathBack').onclick=()=>renderPathways(root);
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-path-day]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const i=+b.dataset.pathDay,focus=focuses[i];document.getElementById('pathWork').innerHTML=`<div class="rjx-practice-box"><div class="rjx-tag">${p[0].toUpperCase()} · DAY ${i+1}</div><h3>${focus}</h3><p>${(i+1)%7===0?'Review the previous days. Write three things that improved, one mistake you still notice and one target for next week.':'Study today’s focus, make three accurate examples, then use it in one longer spoken or written response.'}</p><textarea class="rjx-input" id="pathEntry" style="min-height:120px;resize:vertical" placeholder="Complete Day ${i+1} here..."></textarea><div class="rjx-actions" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="pathDone">Mark day complete</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="pathNext">Next day →</button></div><div class="rjx-feedback" id="pathFb"></div></div>`;document.getElementById('pathDone').onclick=()=>{markDone(`path-${index}-${i}`);const f=document.getElementById('pathFb');f.textContent=`Day ${i+1} marked complete.`;f.classList.add('show');window.rjxPlayCorrect?.()};document.getElementById('pathNext').disabled=i===focuses.length-1;document.getElementById('pathNext').onclick=()=>{const n=root.querySelector(`[data-path-day="${i+1}"]`);n&&n.click()}});
}
function renderProjects(root){

}

  const p=[['Plan a British city weekend','Research, itinerary, budget, spoken presentation and final written plan.'],['Create a job-application pack','CV language, cover letter, interview answers and follow-up email.'],['Opinion mini-project','Read two viewpoints, organise evidence, write an argument and record a spoken summary.'],['Travel problem-solving project','Handle booking changes, complaints, directions and a final travel report.']];

  wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('projBack').onclick=()=>renderProjects(root);root.querySelectorAll('[data-stage]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const i=+b.dataset.stage;document.getElementById('projectWork').innerHTML=`<div class="rjx-practice-box"><div class="rjx-tag">PROJECT ${index+1} · STAGE ${i+1}</div><h3>${stages[i]}</h3><p>${['Read the project goal carefully. Decide what your final result must include.','Build a useful word and phrase bank for this project.','Collect the information or model language you need.','Create your first full attempt. Focus on communicating the message clearly.','Check grammar, vocabulary, organisation and clarity. Improve weak sections.','Prepare the clean final version and use the checklist before finishing.'][i]}</p><textarea class="rjx-input" style="min-height:135px;resize:vertical" placeholder="Work on this project stage here..."></textarea><div class="rjx-actions" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="stageDone">Complete stage</button></div><div class="rjx-feedback" id="stageFb"></div></div>`;document.getElementById('stageDone').onclick=()=>{document.getElementById('stageFb').textContent='Stage complete. Open the next project stage when you are ready.';document.getElementById('stageFb').classList.add('show');window.rjxPlayCorrect?.()}});
}

Revisiting them is the strongest next action.':'No weak area has been recorded yet, so continue with the structured B1 lesson path.'}</p><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="recGo">Start recommended work</button></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('recGo').onclick=()=>{if(m.length){state.section='revision';renderSection()}else{state.section='lessons';state.lesson={level:'B1',unit:0,index:0};renderSection()}};}

// ===== V13 FORENSIC LEARNING-ARCHITECTURE REBUILD =====
// Deep libraries are generated deterministically in-browser so the single-file build stays maintainable.
const RJX_V13_PAGE_SIZE=10;
function rjxEsc(v){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>\"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\"':'&quot;'}[c]))}
function rjxPageControls(page,total,onPage){
  const pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(total/RJX_V13_PAGE_SIZE));
  const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='rjx-bottom-nav';
  wrap.innerHTML=`${page>0?'<button class="rjx-btn" data-pg="prev">← Previous 10</button>':'<span></span>'}<span>Page ${page+1} of ${pages} · ${total} items</span>${page<pages-1?'<button class="rjx-btn primary next" data-pg="next">Next 10 →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">FINAL PAGE ✓</span>'}`;
  wrap.querySelector('[data-pg="prev"]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>onPage(page-1));
  wrap.querySelector('[data-pg="next"]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>onPage(page+1));
  return wrap;
}

// ----- A1–C2: expand EVERY existing unit to 100 complete lesson objects -----
const RJX_V13_FOCUS=['accuracy','fluency','word order','questions','negatives','natural vocabulary','British usage','pronunciation','listening detail','reading detail','speaking confidence','writing accuracy','real-life communication','error correction','collocations','sentence building','review','challenge','mixed practice','mastery'];Object.entries(RJX_LESSONS).forEach(([level,units])=>{
  units.forEach((unit,ui)=>{
    const seed=unit.lessons.slice();
    for(let i=seed.length;i<100;i++){
      const base=seed[i%seed.length]||seed[0];
      const focus=RJX_V13_FOCUS[i%RJX_V13_FOCUS.length];
      const n=i+1;
      unit.lessons.push({
        title:`${unit.name}: ${focus} ${n}`,
        skill:base.skill||unit.skill,
        goal:`Strengthen ${focus} at ${level} level and use it independently in a realistic English task.`,
        teach:`This ${level} lesson develops ${focus} through the topic “${unit.name}”. Notice the model pattern first, then change the subject, time, detail or purpose so you are producing your own English rather than copying one sentence. Keep the language appropriate for ${level} and check word order, verb form and natural vocabulary before you finish.`,
        examples:[`Model ${n}: Use the target language clearly in a short real-life sentence.`,`Variation ${n}: Change one important detail while keeping the grammar accurate.`,`Challenge ${n}: Add a reason, example or follow-up question.`],
        task:`Create four original examples about “${unit.name}”. Include one statement, one negative or contrast, one question, and one extended answer. Focus especially on ${focus}.`,
        model:`A strong answer uses the target pattern accurately, adds a relevant detail and sounds natural rather than memorised.`,
        questions:[
          [`Lesson ${n}: which approach is strongest?`,['Use the target form accurately and add a relevant detail.','Copy the model without changing anything.','Use random difficult words even if the sentence becomes unclear.'],0,'Accuracy plus relevant development is the strongest choice.'],
          [`What should you check before moving on?`,['Word order, verb form and meaning.','Only the number of words.','Nothing — the first attempt is always final.'],0,'A quick accuracy check helps turn practice into learning.'],
          [`What is the best final step?`,['Make one new example of your own.','Memorise the exact model only.','Skip practice and go straight to the next lesson.'],0,'Producing a fresh example proves you can transfer the language.']
        ]
      });
    }
    if(unit.lessons.length>100)unit.lessons.length=100;
  });
});

// ----- Practice: 100 activities inside EACH practice skill -----
const RJX_V13_PRACTICE_TOPICS={
  Grammar:['tenses','questions','negatives','articles','prepositions','conditionals','modals','passives','reported speech','relative clauses'],
  Vocabulary:['daily life','work','travel','feelings','phrasal verbs','collocations','British English','technology','education','advanced precision'],
  Pronunciation:['TH sounds','vowels','word stress','sentence stress','weak forms','linking','intonation','schwa','consonant clusters','British rhythm'],
  Speaking:['introductions','descriptions','stories','opinions','agreement','problem solving','workplace talk','small talk','interviews','two-minute fluency'],
  Reading:['main idea','detail','scanning','inference','reference words','headings','tone','purpose','vocabulary in context','speed reading'],
  Writing:['sentences','punctuation','paragraphs','linking','emails','opinions','descriptions','formal style','editing','advanced cohesion']
};
Object.keys(RJX_PRACTICE).forEach(cat=>{
  const topics=RJX_V13_PRACTICE_TOPICS[cat]||RJX_V13_FOCUS;
  RJX_PRACTICE[cat]=Array.from({length:10},(_,setIndex)=>({name:`${cat} Practice ${setIndex*10+1}–${setIndex*10+10}`,activities:Array.from({length:10},(_,j)=>{
    const n=setIndex*10+j+1,topic=topics[(n-1)%topics.length];
    return {title:`${cat} · ${topic} · Activity ${n}`,kind:'quiz',question:`Activity ${n}: choose the strongest ${cat.toLowerCase()} response for ${topic}.`,options:[`The accurate and natural ${topic} option.`,`An option with a clear ${cat.toLowerCase()} error.`,`An option that does not answer the task.`],correct:0,feedback:`For ${topic}, choose the option that is both accurate and natural. Then create one example of your own before continuing.`};
  })}));
});

// ----- IELTS & TOEIC: exactly 100 interactive modules EACH -----
function rjxMakeExamModule(kind,n){
  const ieltsAreas=['Speaking Part 1','Speaking Part 2','Speaking Part 3','Writing Task 1','Writing Task 2','Reading','Listening','Band 7–9 Language','Academic Vocabulary','Grammar Range'];
  const toeicAreas=['Picture Description','Question–Response','Conversations','Talks & Announcements','Incomplete Sentences','Text Completion','Reading Comprehension','Business Vocabulary','Workplace Grammar','Speed & Accuracy'];
  const area=(kind==='IELTS'?ieltsAreas:toeicAreas)[(n-1)%10];
  const title=`${area} · Mastery ${String(n).padStart(3,'0')}`;
  const desc=`${kind} lesson ${n}: focused ${area.toLowerCase()} training with strategy, model language and a quick check.`;
  RJX_EXAM_BANK[title]={
    teach:`This ${kind} module develops ${area}. Work under exam-style pressure, identify exactly what the task requires, and choose language that is clear, accurate and appropriate. Module ${n} adds another layer of controlled practice so progress comes from repeated, varied exposure rather than one isolated exercise.`,
    strategy:['Read or listen for the exact task','Identify key words and likely distractors','Choose a clear structure before answering','Check accuracy and relevance','Review the explanation before continuing'],
    model:`Module ${n} model: answer the task directly, support it with a relevant detail, and keep the language controlled and natural.`,
    questions:[
      [`${kind} ${n}: what should you do first?`,['Identify the exact task and key information.','Guess before reading or listening.','Use memorised language without checking relevance.'],0,'Start by understanding the exact task.'],
      [`Which response is strongest?`,['A clear, relevant and accurate response.','A long response that does not answer the question.','A difficult response with avoidable grammar errors.'],0,'Relevance and control are more valuable than unnecessary complexity.'],
      [`What should happen before the next module?`,['Review mistakes and make one improved example.','Ignore feedback.','Repeat the same error deliberately.'],0,'Immediate review helps consolidate the skill.']
    ]
  };
  return [title,desc];
}
while(RJX_IELTS.length<100)RJX_IELTS.push(rjxMakeExamModule('IELTS',RJX_IELTS.length+1));
while(RJX_TOEIC.length<100)RJX_TOEIC.push(rjxMakeExamModule('TOEIC',RJX_TOEIC.length+1));
if(RJX_IELTS.length>100)RJX_IELTS.length=100;if(RJX_TOEIC.length>100)RJX_TOEIC.length=100;

// ----- IELTS Cue Cards: 100 cards, each with 1-minute prep + 2-minute speaking -----
const RJX_V13_CUE_TOPICS=['a person who helped you','a memorable journey','a useful object','a place you enjoy','a skill you learned','a difficult decision','a celebration','a book or film','a piece of technology','a goal you achieved','a public place','a conversation you remember','a time you solved a problem','a teacher','a family tradition','a job you would like','a sport or activity','a photo','a change in your life','a useful website'];
while(RJX_CUES.length<100){const n=RJX_CUES.length+1,t=RJX_V13_CUE_TOPICS[(n-1)%RJX_V13_CUE_TOPICS.length];RJX_CUES.push([`CARD ${n}`,`Describe ${t}.`,['what or who it was','when and where it happened','what happened or what you did','and explain why it was important to you']]);}
if(RJX_CUES.length>100)RJX_CUES.length=100;

// ----- Read & Write: each unit becomes a 100-lesson writing journey -----
if(typeof RJX_READWRITE!=='undefined')RJX_READWRITE.forEach((u,ui)=>{const seed=u.lessons.slice();for(let i=seed.length;i<100;i++){const b=seed[i%seed.length]||seed[0];u.lessons.push({title:`${u.title} · Writing Lesson ${i+1}`,teach:`Develop ${u.level} reading and writing through a focused ${u.title.toLowerCase()} task. Read for meaning first, then plan, draft, check capitals and punctuation, improve linking, and produce a cleaner final version.`,task:`Write 80–180 words (appropriate to ${u.level}) connected with ${u.title}. Include a clear opening, developed detail and a final checking pass.`,model:b?.model||'A strong response is clear, organised and carefully checked.'});}if(u.lessons.length>100)u.lessons.length=100;});

// ----- Generic member libraries: every learning/resource section has 100 modules -----
Object.entries(RJX_MEMBER_MODULES).forEach(([key,val])=>{
  const list=val[2],seed=list.slice();
  while(list.length<100){const n=list.length+1,base=seed[(n-1)%seed.length]||val[0];list.push(`${base} · Lesson ${String(n).padStart(3,'0')}`)}
  if(list.length>100)list.length=100;
});

renderLessonUnits=function(root){const l=state.lesson.level,units=RJX_LESSONS[l];root.innerHTML=crumbs([['Memberships','members'],[TIER[state.tier].name,'member'],['Lessons','section'],[`${l} ${RJX_LEVEL_NAMES[l]}`,'section']])+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><strong>${l} ${RJX_LEVEL_NAMES[l]} · 600 lessons</strong><button class="rjx-btn" id="allLevels">← All levels</button></div><div class="rjx-grid2">${units.map((u,i)=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-unit="${i}"><div class="rjx-tag">UNIT ${i+1} · ${u.skill}</div><h3>${u.name}</h3><p>100 connected lessons. renderLessonUnit=function(root){const l=state.lesson.level,u=RJX_LESSONS[l][state.lesson.unit];let page=state.lesson.page||0;const start=page*RJX_V13_PAGE_SIZE,items=u.lessons.slice(start,start+RJX_V13_PAGE_SIZE);root.innerHTML=crumbs([['Memberships','members'],[TIER[state.tier].name,'member'],['Lessons','section'],[l,'section'],[u.name,'section']])+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><div><strong>${l} · Unit ${state.lesson.unit+1}: ${u.name}</strong><br><small>100 lessons · showing ${start+1}–${Math.min(start+10,u.lessons.length)}</small></div><button class="rjx-btn" id="backUnits">← Back to ${l} units</button></div><div class="rjx-list">${items.map((x,i)=>`<div class="rjx-row click" data-lesson="${start+i}"><div><strong>${start+i+1}. ${x.title}</strong><small>${x.skill} · lesson, examples, task and quick check</small></div><span class="rjx-chip">Open lesson</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div id="lessonPager"></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('backUnits').onclick=()=>{state.lesson.unit=null;state.lesson._showUnits=true;state.lesson.page=0;renderMemberLessons(root)};root.querySelectorAll('[data-lesson]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{state.lesson.index=+c.dataset.lesson;renderMemberLessons(root)});document.getElementById('lessonPager').appendChild(rjxPageControls(page,u.lessons.length,p=>{state.lesson.page=p;renderLessonUnit(root)}))};

// ----- Practice: real implementation + 100 activities per skill, paged 10 at a time -----
function rjxPracticeFlat(cat){return (RJX_PRACTICE[cat]||[]).flatMap(s=>s.activities||[]).slice(0,100)}
renderMemberPractice=function(root){const st=state.practice||{cat:null,index:null,page:0};state.practice=st;if(st.index!==null&&st.index!==undefined)return rjxPracticeDetail(root);if(st.cat)return rjxPracticeList(root);root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('Practice Library')+`<div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>Choose a practice skill</h2><p>Every skill contains 100 connected activities. Lists are kept short by showing 10 at a time.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-grid3">${Object.keys(RJX_PRACTICE).map(c=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-prcat="${rjxEsc(c)}"><div class="rjx-tag">${rjxEsc(c).toUpperCase()}</div><h3>100 activities</h3><p>Practice, instant feedback and connected progression.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open ${rjxEsc(c)} →</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;wireCrumbs(root);root.querySelectorAll('[data-prcat]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{state.practice={cat:c.dataset.prcat,index:null,page:0};renderMemberPractice(root)})};
function rjxPracticeList(root){const cat=state.practice.cat,all=rjxPracticeFlat(cat),page=state.practice.page||0,start=page*10,items=all.slice(start,start+10);root.innerHTML=crumbs([['Memberships','members'],[TIER[state.tier].name,'member'],['Practice','section'],[cat,'section']])+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><strong>${rjxEsc(cat)} · 100 activities</strong><button class="rjx-btn" id="practiceCats">← All practice skills</button></div><div class="rjx-list">${items.map((a,i)=>`<div class="rjx-row click" data-pri="${start+i}"><div><strong>${start+i+1}. ${rjxEsc(a.title)}</strong><small>Interactive practice with feedback</small></div><span class="rjx-chip">Open</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div id="practicePager"></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('practiceCats').onclick=()=>{state.practice={cat:null,index:null,page:0};renderMemberPractice(root)};root.querySelectorAll('[data-pri]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{state.practice.index=+b.dataset.pri;rjxPracticeDetail(root)});document.getElementById('practicePager').appendChild(rjxPageControls(page,all.length,p=>{state.practice.page=p;rjxPracticeList(root)}))}
function rjxPracticeDetail(root){const cat=state.practice.cat,all=rjxPracticeFlat(cat),idx=state.practice.index,a=all[idx];root.innerHTML=crumbs([['Memberships','members'],[TIER[state.tier].name,'member'],['Practice','section'],[cat,'section'],[a.title,'section']])+`<article class="rjx-lesson"><div class="rjx-lesson-head"><div class="rjx-tag">${rjxEsc(cat).toUpperCase()} · ACTIVITY ${idx+1} OF 100</div><h2>${rjxEsc(a.title)}</h2><p>Complete the quick check, review the explanation, then continue straight to the next activity.</p></div><div class="rjx-lesson-body"><h3>Quick check</h3><p>${rjxEsc(a.question)}</p><div class="rjx-options">${a.options.map((o,i)=>`<button class="rjx-option" data-pra="${i}">${rjxEsc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-feedback" id="prFb"></div><h3>Your example</h3><textarea class="rjx-input" style="min-height:110px;resize:vertical" placeholder="Create one example of your own before moving on..."></textarea><div class="rjx-actions" style="margin-top:14px"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="prComplete">${idx<all.length-1?'Complete & continue →':'Complete final activity ✓'}</button></div></div></article><div class="rjx-bottom-nav">${idx>0?'<button class="rjx-btn" id="prPrev">← Previous activity</button>':'<span></span>'}<span>Activity ${idx+1} of ${all.length}</span>${idx<all.length-1?'<button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="prNext">Next activity →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">FINAL ACTIVITY ✓</span>'}</div>`;wireCrumbs(root);const opts=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-pra]')];opts.forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(opts.some(x=>x.disabled))return;const pick=+b.dataset.pra;opts.forEach((x,i)=>{x.disabled=true;if(i===a.correct)x.classList.add('correct')});const f=document.getElementById('prFb');if(pick===a.correct){f.textContent=a.feedback;window.rjxPlayCorrect?.()}else{b.classList.add('wrong');f.textContent=`Not quite. ${a.feedback}`;window.rjxPlayWrong?.();addMistake(`practice-${cat}-${idx}`,a.question,a.options[a.correct],a.feedback)}f.classList.add('show')});document.getElementById('prComplete').onclick=()=>{markDone(`practice-${cat}-${idx}`);if(idx<all.length-1){state.practice.index=idx+1;rjxPracticeDetail(root)}else{state.practice.index=null;state.practice.page=9;rjxPracticeList(root)}};document.getElementById('prPrev')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.practice.index=idx-1;rjxPracticeDetail(root)});document.getElementById('prNext')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.practice.index=idx+1;rjxPracticeDetail(root)})}

Free practice remains deliberately small; member practice contains 100 activities in every skill.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-grid3"><div class="rjx-card click" id="goFree"><div class="rjx-tag">FREE SAMPLE</div><h3>Free Practice</h3><p>A short sample of the Academy before joining.</p><span class="rjx-link">Start free sample →</span></div>${Object.keys(RJX_PRACTICE).map(c=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-prhub="${rjxEsc(c)}"><div class="rjx-tag">MEMBERS</div><h3>${rjxEsc(c)} Practice</h3><p>100 connected activities.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open ${rjxEsc(c)} →</span></div>`).join('')}<div class="rjx-card click" id="goCue"><div class="rjx-tag">IELTS</div><h3>IELTS Cue Cards</h3><p>100 Part 2 cue cards with preparation and speaking timers.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open cue cards →</span></div></div>`;document.getElementById('goFree').onclick=()=>show('free');root.querySelectorAll('[data-prhub]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{state.tier='silver';state.section='practice';state.practice={cat:b.dataset.prhub,index:null,page:0};show('section')});document.getElementById('goCue').onclick=()=>{state.tier='gold';state.section='cuecards';show('section')}};

const rjxOldRenderExamCentre=renderExamCentre;
renderExamCentre=function(root,sec){
  if(state.exam.sec!==sec)state.exam={sec,index:null,page:0};
  if(state.exam.index!==null)return rjxOldRenderExamCentre(root,sec);
  const isToeic=sec==='toeic',mods=sec==='advanced-exams'?[...RJX_IELTS,...RJX_TOEIC]:isToeic?RJX_TOEIC:RJX_IELTS,name=sec==='advanced-exams'?'Advanced IELTS & TOEIC Library':isToeic?'TOEIC Centre':'IELTS Centre';
  let page=state.exam.page||0,total=mods.length,start=page*10,items=mods.slice(start,start+10);
  root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(name)+`<div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>${name}</h2><p>${sec==='advanced-exams'?'200 combined modules':'100 connected modules'} · showing ${start+1}–${Math.min(start+10,total)}.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-grid2">${items.map((m,j)=>{const i=start+j,tag=sec==='advanced-exams'?(i<RJX_IELTS.length?'IELTS':'TOEIC'):(isToeic?'TOEIC':'IELTS'),completed=!!storage().done?.[`exam-${sec}-${i}`];return `<div class="rjx-card click" data-exmod="${i}"><div class="rjx-tag">${tag} · ${completed?'✓ COMPLETED':'LESSON '+(i+1)}</div><h3>${rjxEsc(m[0])}</h3><p>${rjxEsc(m[1])}</p><span class="rjx-link">${completed?'Review':'Open'} module →</span></div>`}).join('')}</div><div id="examPager"></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);root.querySelectorAll('[data-exmod]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{state.exam.index=+c.dataset.exmod;rjxOldRenderExamCentre(root,sec);window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})});document.getElementById('examPager').appendChild(rjxPageControls(page,total,p=>{state.exam.page=p;renderExamCentre(root,sec)}));
};

renderExams=function(){const root=document.getElementById('rjxExamsBody');root.innerHTML=`<div class="rjx-grid3"><div class="rjx-card click" id="examIelts"><div class="rjx-tag">IELTS</div><h3>IELTS Centre</h3><p>100 connected IELTS lessons.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open IELTS →</span></div><div class="rjx-card click" id="examToeic"><div class="rjx-tag">TOEIC</div><h3>TOEIC Centre</h3><p>100 connected TOEIC lessons.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open TOEIC →</span></div><div class="rjx-card click" id="examCue"><div class="rjx-tag">IELTS SPEAKING</div><h3>100 Cue Cards</h3><p>1-minute preparation timer + 2-minute speaking timer.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open Cue Cards →</span></div></div>`;document.getElementById('examIelts').onclick=()=>{state.tier='silver';state.section='ielts';state.exam={sec:'ielts',index:null,page:0};show('section')};document.getElementById('examToeic').onclick=()=>{state.tier='silver';state.section='toeic';state.exam={sec:'toeic',index:null,page:0};show('section')};document.getElementById('examCue').onclick=()=>{state.tier='gold';state.section='cuecards';show('section')}};

// ----- Cue cards: hide Next at final card -----
renderCueCards=function(root){let idx=state.cueIndex||0;function draw(){state.cueIndex=idx;const c=RJX_CUES[idx];root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('IELTS Cue Cards')+`<div class="rjx-practice-box"><div class="rjx-tag">IELTS SPEAKING PART 2 · CARD ${idx+1} OF 100</div><h3>${rjxEsc(c[1])}</h3><p>You should say:</p><ul>${c[2].map(x=>`<li>${rjxEsc(x)}</li>`).join('')}</ul><div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn" id="prep">Start 1-minute preparation</button><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="speak2">Start 2-minute speaking</button></div><div class="rjx-timer" id="cueTimer">01:00</div></div><div class="rjx-bottom-nav">${idx>0?'<button class="rjx-btn" id="cuePrev">← Previous card</button>':'<span></span>'}<span>Card ${idx+1} of 100</span>${idx<99?'<button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="cueNext">Next card →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">FINAL CARD ✓</span>'}</div>`;wireCrumbs(root);function timed(s){clearInterval(state.timer);const el=document.getElementById('cueTimer');let n=s;const paint=()=>el.textContent=`${String(Math.floor(n/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(n%60).padStart(2,'0')}`;paint();state.timer=setInterval(()=>{n--;paint();if(n<=0){clearInterval(state.timer);el.textContent='TIME'}},1000)}document.getElementById('prep').onclick=()=>timed(60);document.getElementById('speak2').onclick=()=>timed(120);document.getElementById('cuePrev')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{idx--;draw()});document.getElementById('cueNext')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{idx++;draw()})}draw()};

// ----- Generic member libraries: show 10 of 100 at a time -----
renderGeneric=function(root,sec){const d=RJX_MEMBER_MODULES[sec]||[sec,'Member content',[]];let page=(state.genericPage&&state.genericPage[sec])||0,start=page*10,items=d[2].slice(start,start+10);root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(d[0])+`<div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>${d[0]}</h2><p>${d[1]} · 100 connected modules.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-grid3">${items.map((x,j)=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-gen="${start+j}"><div class="rjx-tag">MODULE ${start+j+1} OF 100</div><h3>${rjxEsc(x)}</h3><p>Explanation, examples, guided practice and review.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open module →</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div id="genericPager"></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);root.querySelectorAll('[data-gen]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>renderGenericDetail(root,sec,+c.dataset.gen));document.getElementById('genericPager').appendChild(rjxPageControls(page,100,p=>{state.genericPage=state.genericPage||{};state.genericPage[sec]=p;renderGeneric(root,sec)}))};

(function rjxBuildPracticeDropdown(){
  const a=nav.querySelector('a[href="#practice"]');if(!a||a.closest('.nav-drop'))return;

  menu.innerHTML=`<button type="button" data-pr-route="free">Free Practice Sample</button>${Object.keys(RJX_PRACTICE).map(c=>`<button type="button" data-pr-skill="${rjxEsc(c)}">${rjxEsc(c)} Practice · 100</button>`).join('')}<button type="button" data-pr-route="cue">IELTS Cue Cards · 100</button>`;wrap.appendChild(menu);
  menu.querySelectorAll('[data-pr-route]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();if(b.dataset.prRoute==='free')show('free');else{state.tier='gold';state.section='cuecards';show('section')}});
  menu.querySelectorAll('[data-pr-skill]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();state.tier='silver';state.section='practice';state.practice={cat:b.dataset.prSkill,index:null,page:0};show('section')});
})();

// Update visible counts in membership overview copy.
const rjxOldRenderMembers=renderMembers;
renderMembers=function(){rjxOldRenderMembers();const root=document.getElementById('rjxMembersBody');const walker=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);const nodes=[];while(walker.nextNode())nodes.push(walker.currentNode);nodes.forEach(n=>{n.nodeValue=n.nodeValue.replaceAll('216 A1–C2 lesson pages','3,600 A1–C2 lesson pages').replaceAll('Full Practice Library','Full Practice Library · 100 per skill').replaceAll('IELTS & TOEIC Centres','IELTS & TOEIC · 100 lessons each').replaceAll('Expanded IELTS & TOEIC','Expanded IELTS & TOEIC · 100 lessons each')})};
// ----- Read & Write: 100 lessons per unit, paged 10 at a time, cross-unit Next -----
renderReadWrite=function(root){
  const st=state.rw;
  if(st.index!==null){
    const u=RJX_READWRITE[st.unit],x=u.lessons[st.index],ui=st.unit,xi=st.index;
    const prev=xi>0?{unit:ui,index:xi-1}:ui>0?{unit:ui-1,index:RJX_READWRITE[ui-1].lessons.length-1}:null;
    const next=xi<u.lessons.length-1?{unit:ui,index:xi+1}:ui<RJX_READWRITE.length-1?{unit:ui+1,index:0}:null;
    root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(x.title)+`<article class="rjx-lesson"><div class="rjx-lesson-head"><div class="rjx-tag">READ & WRITE · ${u.level} · LESSON ${xi+1} OF 100</div><h2>${rjxEsc(x.title)}</h2></div><div class="rjx-lesson-body"><h3>Learn</h3><p>${rjxEsc(x.teach)}</p><h3>Your task</h3><div class="rjx-task">${rjxEsc(x.task)}</div><h3>Writing area</h3><textarea class="rjx-textarea" id="rwText" placeholder="Write your answer here..."></textarea><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="rwSave" style="margin-top:10px">Save draft</button></div></article><div class="rjx-bottom-nav">${prev?'<button class="rjx-btn" id="rwPrev">← Previous lesson</button>':'<span></span>'}<span>Unit ${ui+1} · Lesson ${xi+1}</span>${next?'<button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="rwNext">Next lesson →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">END OF READ & WRITE ✓</span>'}</div><div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="rjx-btn" id="rwBack">← Back to unit</button></div>`;
    wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('rwText').value=draftGet(`rjxDraft-${ui}-${xi}`);document.getElementById('rwSave').onclick=()=>{draftSet(`rjxDraft-${ui}-${xi}`,document.getElementById('rwText').value);markDone(`rw-${ui}-${xi}`);document.getElementById('rwSave').textContent='✓ Draft saved'};
    const go=t=>{st.unit=t.unit;st.index=t.index;st.page=Math.floor(t.index/10);renderReadWrite(root);window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})};if(prev)document.getElementById('rwPrev').onclick=()=>go(prev);if(next)document.getElementById('rwNext').onclick=()=>go(next);document.getElementById('rwBack').onclick=()=>{st.index=null;st.page=Math.floor(xi/10);renderReadWrite(root)};return;
  }
  if(st.unit!==null){const u=RJX_READWRITE[st.unit],page=st.page||0,start=page*10,items=u.lessons.slice(start,start+10);root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(`${u.level} · ${u.title}`)+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><strong>${u.level} · ${u.title} · 100 lessons</strong><button class="rjx-btn" id="rwAll">← All units</button></div><div class="rjx-list">${items.map((x,i)=>`<div class="rjx-row click" data-rw="${start+i}"><div><strong>${start+i+1}. ${rjxEsc(x.title)}</strong><small>Learn · guided task · saved writing draft</small></div><span class="rjx-chip">Open</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div id="rwPager"></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('rwAll').onclick=()=>{st.unit=null;st.page=0;renderReadWrite(root)};root.querySelectorAll('[data-rw]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{st.index=+x.dataset.rw;renderReadWrite(root)});document.getElementById('rwPager').appendChild(rjxPageControls(page,100,p=>{st.page=p;renderReadWrite(root)}));return}
  root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('Read & Write')+`<div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>Read & Write mega-course</h2><p>${RJX_READWRITE.length} units. Every unit contains 100 connected reading/writing lessons.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-grid3">${RJX_READWRITE.map((u,i)=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-rwu="${i}"><div class="rjx-tag">${u.level}</div><h3>${rjxEsc(u.title)}</h3><p>100 lessons with saved drafts.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open 100 lessons →</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;wireCrumbs(root);root.querySelectorAll('[data-rwu]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{st.unit=+x.dataset.rwu;st.page=0;renderReadWrite(root)})
};

show('home');

<script id="rjx-interactive-sounds">
/* RJ Language Academy sound system.
   All sounds are generated in-browser with Web Audio: no external sound files. */
(() => {
  let audioCtx = null;
  let lastOutcomeAt = 0;

  function ctx() {
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContextClass) return null;
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioContextClass();
    if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
    return audioCtx;
  }

  function tone({freq=440, endFreq=null, type='sine', duration=0.08, gain=0.05, delay=0}) {
    const ac = ctx();
    if (!ac) return;
    const now = ac.currentTime + delay;
    const osc = ac.createOscillator();
    const amp = ac.createGain();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
    if (endFreq) {
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(1, endFreq), now + duration);
    }
    amp.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain, now + Math.min(0.015, duration / 4));
    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
    osc.connect(amp);
    amp.connect(ac.destination);
    osc.start(now);
    osc.stop(now + duration + 0.03);
  }

  window.rjxPlayClick = function () {
    tone({freq: 560, endFreq: 390, type: 'sine', duration: 0.045, gain: 0.032});
  };

  /* Bell-like correct answer: bright fundamental plus two quiet overtones. */
  window.rjxPlayCorrect = function () {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - lastOutcomeAt < 90) return;
    lastOutcomeAt = now;
    tone({freq: 880, type: 'sine', duration: 0.42, gain: 0.085});
    tone({freq: 1760, type: 'sine', duration: 0.30, gain: 0.038, delay: 0.006});
    tone({freq: 2640, type: 'sine', duration: 0.19, gain: 0.020, delay: 0.012});
  };

  /* Wrong-answer buzzer: low, rough and clearly different from the bell. */
  window.rjxPlayWrong = function () {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - lastOutcomeAt < 90) return;
    lastOutcomeAt = now;
    tone({freq: 175, endFreq: 105, type: 'sawtooth', duration: 0.34, gain: 0.065});
    tone({freq: 118, endFreq: 82, type: 'square', duration: 0.29, gain: 0.030, delay: 0.035});
  };

  /* General click feedback only. Question handlers play their own bell/buzzer. */
  document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    const pressed = event.target.closest(
      'button, a, [role="button"], .click, .rjx-row, .rj-row, .rjx-member-level, .rj-member-tool, .rj-silver-card, .rj-silver-resource'
    );
    if (!pressed || pressed.disabled || pressed.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return;
    window.rjxPlayClick();
  });
})();
</script>
