<script id="rjx-v14-exam-js">
(function(){
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>\"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));
const IELTS_SECTIONS=[
  {key:'listening',name:'Listening',icon:'🎧',desc:'Form completion, maps, multiple choice, note completion and inference.'},
  {key:'reading',name:'Reading',icon:'📖',desc:'Headings, T/F/NG, summaries, matching information and inference.'},
  {key:'writing',name:'Writing',icon:'✍️',desc:'Task 1 visuals, Task 2 planning, cohesion, grammar and Band 7–9 development.'},
  {key:'speaking',name:'Speaking',icon:'🎙️',desc:'Part 1, Cue Cards, Part 3, fluency, vocabulary and pronunciation.'}
];
const TOEIC_SECTIONS=[
  {key:'p1',name:'Part 1 · Photographs',icon:'📷',desc:'10 matched photo lessons using 10 different realistic workplace, travel, service and public-setting photographs.'},
  {key:'p2',name:'Part 2 · Question–Response',icon:'💬',desc:'WH questions, yes/no questions, suggestions and indirect replies.'},
  {key:'p3',name:'Part 3 · Conversations',icon:'👥',desc:'Workplace conversations with purpose, detail and inference questions.'},
  {key:'p4',name:'Part 4 · Talks',icon:'📢',desc:'Announcements, voicemails, presentations and public information.'},
  {key:'p5',name:'Part 5 · Incomplete Sentences',icon:'🧩',desc:'Grammar, vocabulary, collocations and business English precision.'},
  {key:'p6',name:'Part 6 · Text Completion',icon:'📨',desc:'Emails, notices, memos and linked-text completion.'},
  {key:'p7',name:'Part 7 · Reading',icon:'📰',desc:'Emails, adverts, schedules, forms and multiple-passage reading.'}
];
const IELTS_TOPICS={
 listening:['Names and numbers','Travel bookings','Campus orientation','Map labelling','Multiple choice','Note completion','Form completion','Table completion','Matching speakers','Section 3 discussion','Academic lecture','Distractor language','Spelling accuracy','Prediction skills','Signposting','Dates and prices','Addresses and postcodes','Synonyms in listening','Following directions','Opinions and attitudes','Purpose and function','Sentence completion','Diagram labelling','Checking word limits','Band 7 listening precision'],
 reading:['Matching headings','True False Not Given','Yes No Not Given','Sentence completion','Summary completion','Matching information','Matching features','Multiple choice','Short answers','Table completion','Flow-chart completion','Diagram labels','Skimming','Scanning','Reference words','Synonym recognition','Main ideas','Writer opinion','Inference','Paragraph purpose','Speed reading','Unknown vocabulary','Comparing claims','Locating evidence','Band 7 reading precision'],
 writing:['Task 1 overview','Line graphs','Bar charts','Pie charts','Tables','Mixed charts','Maps','Processes','Task 1 comparisons','Task 1 language','Task 2 opinion essays','Discussion essays','Problem-solution essays','Advantages-disadvantages','Two-part questions','Thesis statements','Topic sentences','Paragraph development','Examples and support','Cohesion','Lexical resource','Grammar range','Error correction','Band comparison','Band 7–9 polishing'],
 speaking:['Part 1 fluency','Part 1 extension','Natural vocabulary','Pronunciation','Stress and rhythm','Cue-card planning','Cue-card timing','Storytelling','Describing people','Describing places','Describing objects','Past experiences','Future plans','Opinions','Part 3 development','Part 3 comparison','Part 3 causes','Part 3 consequences','Abstract ideas','Paraphrasing','Self-correction','Avoiding memorisation','Collocations','Two-minute fluency','Band 7–9 speaking']
};
const TOEIC_TOPICS={
 p1:['Coffee shop conversation','Office presentation','Hotel check-in','Airport boarding gate','Warehouse inventory','Restaurant service','Train platform','Construction site','Retail consultation','Office reception'],
 p2:['Where questions','When questions','Who questions','Why questions','How questions','Which questions','Yes/no questions','Requests','Offers','Suggestions','Indirect replies','Negative questions','Tag questions','Choice questions','Workplace small talk'],
 p3:['Scheduling','Customer service','Travel changes','Office supplies','Project updates','Restaurant booking','Hotel issue','Delivery delay','Meeting arrangements','Training session','IT support','Job interview','Sales enquiry','Conference planning','Facility problem'],
 p4:['Airport announcement','Train announcement','Voicemail','Weather update','Store announcement','Company presentation','Tour information','Radio advert','Meeting introduction','Safety notice','Shipping update','Event announcement','Recorded message','Public service notice','Business briefing'],
 p5:['Parts of speech','Verb tense','Subject-verb agreement','Prepositions','Conjunctions','Relative clauses','Gerunds/infinitives','Comparatives','Pronouns','Articles','Word forms','Collocations','Conditionals','Passive voice','Business vocabulary'],
 p6:['Business email','Internal memo','Customer notice','Job advertisement','Office announcement','Travel update','Service message','Newsletter','Event invitation','Policy update','Product notice','Meeting follow-up','Shipping message','Complaint response','Training email'],
 p7:['Single email','Advertisement','Schedule','Invoice','Form','Notice','Text messages','Webpage','Double passage','Triple passage','Email + schedule','Advert + email','Form + notice','Invoice + message','Multiple documents']
};
const ACT_TYPES=['mcq','gap','match','sort','error','paraphrase','flash','compare','type','timer'];
function buildMods(kind){
 const sections=kind==='ielts'?IELTS_SECTIONS:TOEIC_SECTIONS; const topics=kind==='ielts'?IELTS_TOPICS:TOEIC_TOPICS; const total=100; let out=[];
 const counts=kind==='ielts'?[25,25,25,25]:[10,15,15,15,15,15,15];
 sections.forEach((s,si)=>{for(let i=0;i<counts[si];i++){const arr=topics[s.key]; const topic=arr[i%arr.length]; const round=Math.floor(i/arr.length)+1; out.push({kind,section:s.key,sectionName:s.name,title:`${topic}${round>1?' · Advanced '+round:''}`,desc:lessonDesc(kind,s.key,topic,i),activity:kind==='toeic'&&s.key==='p1'?'photo':ACT_TYPES[(i+si)%ACT_TYPES.length],localIndex:i});}}); return out.slice(0,total);
}
function lessonDesc(kind,sec,topic,i){if(kind==='ielts') return `Practise ${topic.toLowerCase()} with strategy, guided examples and an interactive task that becomes more demanding as you progress.`; return `TOEIC ${topic.toLowerCase()} practice using realistic workplace, travel and business English.`}
const IELTS_MODS=buildMods('ielts'), TOEIC_MODS=buildMods('toeic');
const V14={exam:{kind:null,section:null,index:null,page:0},cueIndex:0,timer:null,score:0,attempts:0};

const CUES=[
['A person who helped you','Describe a person who helped you at an important time.',['who the person is','when they helped you','what they did','why their help mattered'],['supportive','reassuring','went out of their way','made a lasting impression'],['To begin with','What stood out most was','Looking back','The main reason I remember this is'],['a teacher before an exam','a colleague during a difficult project','a family member after a move'],`I’d like to talk about a teacher who helped me when I was preparing for an important exam. I was feeling overwhelmed because I was trying to study everything at once. She sat down with me, helped me make a realistic plan and showed me how to focus on my weakest areas first. What stood out most was how calm and reassuring she was. Instead of simply telling me to work harder, she gave me a practical method. Looking back, her advice mattered because it changed the way I approach difficult goals, and I still use the same planning technique now.`,['Why do some people find it difficult to ask for help?','Should schools teach students how to support one another?','Has technology changed the way people help each other?']],
['A memorable journey','Describe a journey you remember well.',['where you went','who you travelled with','what happened during the journey','why you remember it'],['scenic route','unexpected delay','memorable experience','well worth the trip'],['One journey that comes to mind','At first','What made it memorable was','In the end'],['a train trip through the countryside','a flight abroad','a road trip with friends'],`One journey that comes to mind is a train trip I took through the countryside. I travelled with two friends, and although the journey was supposed to be straightforward, our train was delayed for nearly an hour. At first we were frustrated, but we eventually started chatting with other passengers and enjoying the scenery. What made it memorable was the contrast between the inconvenience and how enjoyable the day became. In the end, the delay actually gave us more time to talk and made the trip feel less rushed.`,['Why do people enjoy travelling?','How could public transport be improved?','Will virtual travel reduce the need for real travel?']],
['A useful skill you learned','Describe a useful skill you learned.',['what the skill is','how you learned it','how long it took','why it is useful'],['practical skill','learning curve','build confidence','come in handy'],['The skill I’d choose is','I picked it up by','At first I struggled with','Nowadays'],['cooking','public speaking','using new software'],`The skill I’d choose is public speaking. I first started learning it because I had to give short presentations at work. At first I struggled with nerves and spoke far too quickly, so I began recording myself and practising in front of small groups. The learning curve was quite steep, but after a few months I became much more confident. Nowadays it comes in handy in meetings and interviews because I can organise my ideas quickly and explain them clearly.`,['Which skills are most important for young people today?','Is it better to learn skills online or face to face?','Why do some people stop learning new skills as they get older?']],
['A place you like to relax','Describe a place where you like to relax.',['where it is','what it looks like','what you do there','why it helps you relax'],['peaceful atmosphere','unwind','get away from it all','clear my head'],['My favourite place to unwind is','What I like about it is','Whenever I go there','It helps me'],['a park','a quiet café','a room at home'],`My favourite place to unwind is a small park near where I live. It has a lake, several walking paths and plenty of trees, so even though it is close to the town centre it feels surprisingly peaceful. I usually walk there in the late afternoon and sometimes sit on a bench with a coffee. Whenever I go there, I feel as though I can get away from it all for a while. It helps me clear my head because there are fewer distractions and I can simply slow down.`,['Why are green spaces important in cities?','Do people relax differently now than in the past?','Should employers provide spaces for staff to relax?']],
['An interesting book or article','Describe something interesting you read.',['what it was','where you found it','what it was about','why it interested you'],['thought-provoking','eye-opening','well-researched','broaden my perspective'],['I recently read','It focused on','I found it particularly interesting because','It made me think about'],['a news feature','a biography','a science article'],`I recently read a long article about how cities are redesigning streets to make them safer for cyclists and pedestrians. It focused on several European cities and included examples of roads that had been changed dramatically. I found it particularly interesting because the article did not just argue for one approach; it compared the benefits with concerns from local businesses and drivers. It was quite thought-provoking and broadened my perspective on how difficult urban planning can be.`,['Do people read less now than before?','What makes online information trustworthy?','Should schools encourage more non-fiction reading?']],
['A piece of technology you use often','Describe a piece of technology you use regularly.',['what it is','how long you have used it','what you use it for','why it is important to you'],['indispensable','user-friendly','streamline','rely on'],['The device I rely on most is','I mainly use it for','What makes it useful is','I would find it difficult to'],['smartphone','laptop','wireless headphones'],`The device I rely on most is my laptop. I mainly use it for work, studying and staying in touch with people. What makes it useful is that it allows me to do several different things in one place, from writing documents to joining video calls. Over time it has become almost indispensable because it streamlines tasks that would otherwise take much longer. I would find it difficult to work efficiently without it.`,['Has technology made people more productive?','What are the disadvantages of depending on technology?','Should children have limits on screen time?']],
['A celebration you enjoyed','Describe a celebration you enjoyed.',['what the celebration was','where it happened','who was there','why you enjoyed it'],['festive atmosphere','get together','special occasion','memorable'],['One celebration I really enjoyed was','The atmosphere was','What made it special was','I remember it because'],['birthday','wedding','national festival'],`One celebration I really enjoyed was a close friend’s wedding. It took place in a small countryside venue, and most of our old friends were there. The atmosphere was warm and festive rather than overly formal. What made it special was the chance to see people I had not met for years. We spent most of the evening talking, laughing and sharing old stories. I remember it because it felt like more than a wedding; it was also a reunion.`,['Why are celebrations important?','Have celebrations become too commercial?','How do public festivals benefit communities?']],
['A difficult decision','Describe a difficult decision you made.',['what the decision was','why it was difficult','what you considered','how you felt afterwards'],['weigh up the options','uncertain outcome','take a risk','in hindsight'],['I once had to decide whether','The difficult part was','I weighed up','In hindsight'],['changing jobs','moving home','starting a course'],`I once had to decide whether to change jobs. The difficult part was that my existing job was secure, while the new opportunity seemed more interesting but less predictable. I weighed up the salary, the commute, the chance to learn new skills and the long-term prospects. Eventually I decided to take the risk. In hindsight, it was the right choice because I gained experience that I probably would not have developed otherwise.`,['Why do some people avoid making decisions?','Should important decisions be based more on logic or emotion?','How can people learn to make better decisions?']],
['A meal you enjoyed','Describe a meal you particularly enjoyed.',['where you ate it','who you were with','what you ate','why it was memorable'],['freshly prepared','full of flavour','local speciality','relaxed setting'],['A meal I remember clearly was','We decided to try','What I liked most was','It was memorable because'],['street food abroad','family dinner','restaurant meal'],`A meal I remember clearly was one I had at a small local restaurant while travelling. We decided to try several dishes we had never eaten before, including a local speciality recommended by the waiter. Everything was freshly prepared and full of flavour. What I liked most was the relaxed setting and the fact that the staff explained the ingredients to us. It was memorable because the meal became part of the travel experience rather than simply something we ate.`,['Why is food important to culture?','Are traditional diets disappearing?','Why do people enjoy eating in restaurants?']],
['A time you were very busy','Describe a period when you were very busy.',['when it was','what you had to do','how you organised your time','how you felt'],['tight schedule','prioritise','under pressure','stay on top of'],['There was a period when','My schedule was','To stay on top of everything','Although it was stressful'],['work deadline','exam period','moving house'],`There was a period when I was working full time while also preparing for an exam. My schedule was extremely tight because I had to fit study sessions around work and other responsibilities. To stay on top of everything, I planned the week in advance and prioritised the most important tasks. Although it was stressful, it taught me that I work much better when I break large goals into smaller daily targets.`,['Why are people busier nowadays?','Can being busy ever be positive?','How should employers help workers manage workload?']],
['A person you admire','Describe someone you admire.',['who the person is','how you know about them','what qualities they have','why you admire them'],['resilient','down-to-earth','set an example','dedicated'],['Someone I admire is','What stands out about them is','They have shown','That is why'],['family member','athlete','public figure'],`Someone I admire is a former colleague who built a new career after losing his previous job. What stands out about him is how resilient and down-to-earth he remained. Instead of complaining about the situation, he learned new skills, asked for advice and gradually moved into a completely different field. He set an example for me because he showed that setbacks do not necessarily define what happens next.`,['What qualities make someone a good role model?','Do celebrities have a responsibility to behave well?','Why do young people need role models?']],
['A beautiful natural place','Describe a natural place you found beautiful.',['where it is','when you went there','what you saw','why it impressed you'],['breathtaking','unspoilt','scenery','sense of scale'],['The place that impressed me most was','The scenery was','What struck me was','I would love to'],['mountain area','beach','forest'],`The place that impressed me most was a coastal area I visited during a holiday. The scenery was breathtaking, with steep cliffs, a wide beach and very few buildings. What struck me was how unspoilt it felt compared with busier tourist destinations. The sound of the sea and the sense of scale made the place feel completely different from everyday city life. I would love to return and spend more time exploring the walking routes.`,['Why should natural areas be protected?','Can tourism damage beautiful places?','How can cities give people more contact with nature?']],
['An event you attended','Describe an event you attended and enjoyed.',['what the event was','where it took place','who you went with','what you enjoyed'],['well-organised','lively atmosphere','highlight','worth attending'],['I attended','The event took place','The highlight for me was','Overall'],['concert','sports event','conference'],`I attended a small music festival last summer with a group of friends. The event took place in a park and included several live performances as well as food stalls. The highlight for me was discovering a band I had never heard before. The event was well-organised and the atmosphere was lively without being too crowded. Overall, it was definitely worth attending because it combined good music with a relaxed day outdoors.`,['Why do people enjoy live events?','Are large events good for cities?','Will online events replace some physical events?']],
['A useful website or app','Describe a website or app you find useful.',['what it is','how you discovered it','how you use it','why it is useful'],['reliable source','easy to navigate','save time','keep track of'],['One app I use regularly is','I first found it when','I mainly use it to','What makes it useful is'],['language app','maps app','banking app'],`One app I use regularly is a mapping app. I first started relying on it when I was travelling more often and needed to plan unfamiliar journeys. I mainly use it to compare routes, check public transport and estimate travel times. What makes it useful is that it saves time and reduces uncertainty, especially when there are delays. It is also easy to navigate, so I can use it quickly even when I am in a hurry.`,['How have apps changed daily life?','Should people worry about how apps use personal data?','What kinds of apps will become more important in the future?']],
['A goal you want to achieve','Describe a goal you would like to achieve.',['what the goal is','why it matters to you','what you need to do','how long it may take'],['long-term goal','work towards','stay motivated','realistic milestone'],['One goal I’m working towards is','It matters to me because','To achieve it','I expect it will take'],['learn a language','change career','save money'],`One goal I’m working towards is becoming much more confident in another language. It matters to me because I would like to communicate comfortably when travelling and possibly use the language professionally in the future. To achieve it, I need consistent speaking practice rather than only studying vocabulary. I have set realistic milestones, such as holding a ten-minute conversation without switching languages. I expect it will take quite a long time, but that actually helps me focus on steady progress rather than quick results.`,['Why do people give up on goals?','Is competition useful for motivation?','Should children be taught goal-setting?']],
['A film you enjoyed','Describe a film you enjoyed.',['what the film was','when you watched it','what it was about','why you liked it'],['engaging','well-paced','memorable performance','thought-provoking'],['A film I enjoyed recently was','The story follows','What I liked most was','I would recommend it because'],['drama','documentary','comedy'],`A film I enjoyed recently was a drama about a family adapting to a major change in their lives. The story itself was quite simple, but the characters were believable and the performances were memorable. What I liked most was that the film did not try to make every situation dramatic; some of the strongest scenes were very quiet. I would recommend it because it was engaging and thought-provoking without feeling unrealistic.`,['Why are films so influential?','Should films mainly entertain or educate?','How has streaming changed cinema?']],
['A time you learned from a mistake','Describe a mistake that taught you something.',['what happened','why the mistake happened','what the result was','what you learned'],['overlook','take responsibility','lesson learned','avoid repeating'],['I once made the mistake of','It happened because','The immediate result was','The main lesson I learned was'],['missing a deadline','booking error','communication mistake'],`I once made the mistake of assuming that a work deadline had been moved without checking it properly. It happened because I relied on an informal conversation rather than confirming the information. The immediate result was that I had to finish the task very quickly. I took responsibility for the mistake and managed to complete it, but it was stressful. The main lesson I learned was to confirm important details in writing and not rely on assumptions.`,['Why are mistakes useful for learning?','Why do some organisations punish mistakes heavily?','How can schools make students less afraid of failure?']],
['A crowded place','Describe a crowded place you visited.',['where it was','why you were there','what it was like','how you felt'],['packed','bustling','overwhelming','lively'],['One particularly crowded place was','I was there because','The area was','I felt'],['market','station','festival'],`One particularly crowded place was a large market I visited while travelling. I was there because several people had recommended it as a good place to try local food. The area was packed with shoppers and the narrow paths made it difficult to move quickly. At first I found it slightly overwhelming, but after a while I enjoyed the lively atmosphere. It felt like a good place to observe everyday local life.`,['Why are cities becoming more crowded?','What problems does overcrowding cause?','Should governments limit visitor numbers at popular places?']],
['A gift you received','Describe a gift that was meaningful to you.',['what the gift was','who gave it to you','when you received it','why it mattered'],['thoughtful','sentimental value','meaningful','remind me of'],['A gift that means a lot to me is','It was given to me by','What made it special was','Whenever I see it'],['book','watch','handmade object'],`A gift that means a lot to me is a book given to me by a close friend. It was not expensive, but my friend had written a personal message inside explaining why he thought I would enjoy it. What made it special was the thought behind it rather than the object itself. Whenever I see it on my shelf, it reminds me of that friendship and of a particular period in my life.`,['Why do people give gifts?','Are expensive gifts more meaningful?','How has online shopping changed gift-giving?']],
['An important conversation','Describe an important conversation you had.',['who you spoke to','what you discussed','why it was important','what happened afterwards'],['honest discussion','clear the air','different perspective','reach a decision'],['I had an important conversation with','We talked about','What made it important was','Afterwards'],['career advice','relationship issue','future plans'],`I had an important conversation with a friend when I was considering a career change. We talked about what I actually enjoyed doing, what I was good at and what risks I was willing to take. What made it important was that my friend asked questions rather than simply telling me what to do. That gave me a different perspective and helped me reach my own decision. Afterwards, I made a practical plan instead of continuing to worry about it.`,['Why are face-to-face conversations important?','Do people communicate less deeply online?','What makes someone a good listener?']],
['A local business you like','Describe a local business you like.',['what it is','where it is','what it sells or does','why you like it'],['independent business','friendly service','regular customer','good value'],['There is a local','It specialises in','What I like about it is','I keep going back because'],['café','bookshop','bakery'],`There is a local café near my home that I visit quite regularly. It is an independent business and mainly serves coffee, simple meals and homemade cakes. What I like about it is the friendly service and relaxed atmosphere. The staff recognise regular customers, which makes the place feel more personal than a large chain. I keep going back because the quality is consistent and it is a comfortable place to meet someone or work for an hour.`,['Why are small businesses important?','Why do some people prefer large chains?','How can local businesses compete with online companies?']],
['A time you waited for something','Describe a time you had to wait for something important.',['what you were waiting for','how long you waited','what you did while waiting','how you felt'],['anticipation','uncertain','patient','worth the wait'],['I once had to wait for','The wait lasted','During that time','When it finally happened'],['exam result','job offer','travel document'],`I once had to wait several weeks for the result of an important application. The wait felt longer than it actually was because I did not know what the outcome would be. During that time, I tried to stay busy and avoid checking my email constantly. When the result finally arrived, I felt an enormous sense of relief. Looking back, the experience taught me to be more patient when something is outside my control.`,['Why are people less patient nowadays?','Has technology made waiting easier or harder?','When is waiting unavoidable?']],
['A sport or exercise','Describe a sport or exercise you enjoy.',['what it is','how often you do it','where you do it','why you enjoy it'],['keep fit','clear my head','build stamina','low-impact'],['The exercise I enjoy most is','I usually do it','What I like about it is','It also helps me'],['walking','swimming','cycling'],`The exercise I enjoy most is walking, especially longer walks at weekends. I usually do it in parks or around quieter areas rather than on busy roads. What I like about it is that it is simple and does not require special equipment. It also helps me clear my head after spending a lot of time indoors. Although it is not an intense sport, it is a realistic way for me to stay active consistently.`,['Why do some people dislike exercise?','Should governments spend more on public sports facilities?','Is competitive sport important for children?']],
['A teacher you remember','Describe a teacher you remember well.',['who the teacher was','what they taught','what they were like','why you remember them'],['encouraging','demanding','bring a subject to life','high expectations'],['A teacher I remember clearly is','They taught','What made them different was','I still remember them because'],['school teacher','college tutor','trainer'],`A teacher I remember clearly is my secondary-school English teacher. She was quite demanding but also very encouraging. What made her different was her ability to bring a subject to life rather than simply following a textbook. She expected us to explain our ideas and defend our opinions, which was challenging at the time. I still remember her because those lessons improved not only my English but also my confidence in expressing myself.`,['What makes a teacher effective?','Will technology reduce the importance of teachers?','Should teachers be strict?']],
['A change that improved your life','Describe a change that improved your life.',['what changed','why you made the change','what was difficult about it','how it improved things'],['positive change','adjust to','new routine','make a difference'],['A change that made a difference was','I decided to','The hardest part was','After a few weeks'],['exercise routine','new job','better sleep schedule'],`A change that made a difference was creating a much more regular daily routine. I decided to plan my work, exercise and rest more deliberately because I often felt as though I was reacting to whatever happened. The hardest part was being consistent for the first few weeks. After that, the routine became easier and I noticed that I was less stressed and more productive. The change was simple, but it improved several areas of my life at once.`,['Why do people resist change?','Are major life changes easier when people are young?','How can organisations manage change successfully?']],
['A photograph you like','Describe a photograph that is important to you.',['what is in the photograph','when it was taken','who took it','why you like it'],['capture a moment','sentimental','bring back memories','candid'],['One photograph I really like shows','It was taken','I like it because','Whenever I look at it'],['family photo','travel photo','celebration photo'],`One photograph I really like shows several members of my family sitting together outside during a summer gathering. It was taken quite casually, so nobody is posing or looking directly at the camera. I like it because it captures a real moment rather than a formal picture. Whenever I look at it, it brings back memories of that day and reminds me how rarely everyone is in the same place at the same time.`,['Why do people take so many photographs now?','Are printed photographs still important?','Can photographs change how we remember events?']],
['A time you gave advice','Describe a time you gave someone advice.',['who you advised','what the problem was','what advice you gave','what happened'],['practical advice','talk something through','weigh up options','supportive'],['I once gave advice to','They were unsure about','I suggested that','In the end'],['friend changing jobs','student preparing for exam','family member buying something'],`I once gave advice to a friend who was unsure whether to accept a new job. Rather than telling him what I thought he should do, I suggested that he write down the advantages and disadvantages and think about which factors would matter in a year’s time. We talked the situation through, especially the opportunities for training and career progression. In the end he accepted the role, and later said the discussion had helped him make the decision more calmly.`,['Why do people sometimes ignore good advice?','Who should young people ask for advice?','Is professional advice becoming more common?']],
['A public place that should improve','Describe a public place you think could be improved.',['what the place is','where it is','what is wrong with it','how it could improve'],['run-down','accessible','well-maintained','public facility'],['A place that could definitely be improved is','The main problem is','I think the authorities should','That would make it'],['station','park','shopping area'],`A place that could definitely be improved is a small train station near my area. The main problem is that the waiting area is uncomfortable and there is very little information when services are delayed. I think the authorities should improve the seating, provide clearer digital displays and make the station more accessible. That would make it more practical for commuters and also create a better first impression for visitors.`,['Who should pay for public-space improvements?','What makes a public place successful?','Should cities prioritise cars or pedestrians?']],
['Something you bought that was useful','Describe something you bought that was very useful.',['what it was','why you bought it','how often you use it','why it was worth buying'],['good investment','practical','durable','value for money'],['One purchase that turned out to be useful was','I bought it because','I use it','It was worth the money because'],['office chair','small appliance','travel bag'],`One purchase that turned out to be useful was a good-quality office chair. I bought it because I was spending more time working at a desk and my old chair was uncomfortable. I use it almost every day, so it has probably been one of my most practical purchases. It was worth the money because it is durable and has made long periods of work much more comfortable.`,['Why do people sometimes buy things they do not need?','Is quality more important than price?','How does advertising influence purchasing decisions?']],
['A time you were surprised','Describe a time something surprised you.',['what happened','where you were','who was involved','why it surprised you'],['unexpected','caught me off guard','pleasant surprise','had no idea'],['I was genuinely surprised when','I had no idea that','What caught me off guard was','It turned out to be'],['surprise visit','unexpected result','gift'],`I was genuinely surprised when some friends organised a small gathering for my birthday. I had no idea that they had planned anything because everyone had acted completely normally beforehand. What caught me off guard was seeing people there who had travelled quite a long way. It turned out to be a very pleasant surprise, mainly because the effort they had made meant more to me than the event itself.`,['Why do people like surprises?','Are surprises always positive?','Why do companies use surprise offers and promotions?']],
['A rule you think is useful','Describe a rule you think is useful.',['what the rule is','where it applies','why it exists','why you think it is useful'],['reasonable rule','protect the public','clear guideline','encourage'],['One rule I think is sensible is','It applies to','The purpose is to','I support it because'],['seat belts','quiet zones','workplace safety'],`One rule I think is sensible is the requirement to wear seat belts in cars. It applies to drivers and passengers and the purpose is obviously to reduce injuries during accidents. I support it because it is a simple action that can have a major effect on safety. It also creates a clear expectation, so people are more likely to develop the habit automatically.`,['Why do societies need rules?','Are there too many rules in modern life?','When should rules be changed?']],
['A new activity you tried','Describe a new activity you tried.',['what it was','why you tried it','what happened','whether you would do it again'],['step outside my comfort zone','beginner','challenging','rewarding'],['I recently tried','I decided to try it because','At first','I would definitely'],['dance class','kayaking','cooking workshop'],`I recently tried a cooking workshop focused on food from another country. I decided to try it because I wanted to learn something practical and step outside my normal routine. At first I was slightly nervous because some of the techniques were unfamiliar, but the instructor explained everything clearly. By the end, I had made several dishes and felt surprisingly confident. I would definitely do something similar again because it was both challenging and rewarding.`,['Why do adults sometimes avoid new activities?','Should schools expose students to more practical activities?','How can hobbies improve wellbeing?']],
['A piece of good news','Describe some good news you received.',['what the news was','when you received it','how you heard it','how you reacted'],['relieved','delighted','look forward to','positive outcome'],['One piece of good news I remember was','I found out','My first reaction was','It mattered because'],['job offer','exam result','family news'],`One piece of good news I remember was being offered a job I had applied for. I found out by email after waiting for several days. My first reaction was relief because the interview process had been quite demanding, and then I felt excited about starting something new. It mattered because the role offered better opportunities to learn and gave me a clear sense of progress at that point in my career.`,['Why do people enjoy sharing good news?','Has social media changed how people share personal news?','Why can waiting for news be stressful?']]
];

function examSections(kind){return kind==='ielts'?IELTS_SECTIONS:TOEIC_SECTIONS}
function examMods(kind){return kind==='ielts'?IELTS_MODS:TOEIC_MODS}
function doneKey(kind,i){return `v14-${kind}-${i}`}
function isDone(kind,i){try{return !!storage().done?.[doneKey(kind,i)]}catch(e){return false}}
function renderExamCentre(root,sec){
 const kind=sec==='toeic'?'toeic':'ielts'; if(V14.exam.kind!==kind){V14.exam={kind,section:null,index:null,page:0}}
 const sections=examSections(kind), mods=examMods(kind), name=kind==='toeic'?'TOEIC Learning Centre':'IELTS Learning Centre';
 if(V14.exam.index!==null) return drawExamLesson(root,sec,kind,mods,V14.exam.index,name);
 if(!V14.exam.section){
  const completed=mods.filter((_,i)=>isDone(kind,i)).length;
  root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(name)+`<div class="rjx-exam-hero"><div class="rjx-tag" style="background:#fff;color:#07172f">RJ LANGUAGE ACADEMY</div><h2>${name}</h2><p>${kind==='ielts'?'A complete four-skill IELTS course with varied activities, Band 7–9 development, 30 Speaking Cue Cards and exam-style practice.':'A seven-part TOEIC course with visual photograph practice, workplace conversations, announcements, business texts and varied interactive exercises.'}</p><div class="rjx-exam-stats"><span class="rjx-exam-stat">100 lessons</span><span class="rjx-exam-stat">${completed} completed</span><span class="rjx-exam-stat">10+ activity formats</span>${kind==='ielts'?'<span class="rjx-exam-stat">30 Cue Cards</span>':'<span class="rjx-exam-stat">Visual Part 1 bank</span>'}</div></div><div class="rjx-section-grid">${sections.map(s=>`<div class="rjx-section-card" data-v14sec="${s.key}"><div class="emoji">${s.icon}</div><h3>${s.name}</h3><p>${s.desc}</p><span class="rjx-link">Open section →</span></div>`).join('')}${kind==='ielts'?`<div class="rjx-section-card" id="v14Cue"><div class="emoji">🗣️</div><h3>IELTS Speaking Cue Cards</h3><p>30 full Part 2 cards with timers, vocabulary, linking language, model answers and Part 3 follow-up.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open Cue Card Centre →</span></div>`:''}</div>`;
  wireCrumbs(root); root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14sec]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{V14.exam.section=x.dataset.v14sec;V14.exam.page=0;renderExamCentre(root,sec);window.scrollTo(0,0)}); if(kind==='ielts')document.getElementById('v14Cue').onclick=()=>renderCueCards(root); return;
 }
 const s=sections.find(x=>x.key===V14.exam.section), filtered=mods.map((m,i)=>({...m,globalIndex:i})).filter(m=>m.section===s.key), pages=Math.ceil(filtered.length/10), pg=Math.min(V14.exam.page,pages-1), shown=filtered.slice(pg*10,pg*10+10);
 root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(name)+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><div><strong>${s.icon} ${s.name}</strong><br><small>${filtered.length} lessons · 10 shown at a time</small></div><button class="rjx-btn" id="v14AllSecs">← All sections</button></div><div class="rjx-grid2">${shown.map((m,j)=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-v14lesson="${m.globalIndex}"><div class="rjx-tag">${isDone(kind,m.globalIndex)?'✓ COMPLETED':'LESSON '+(pg*10+j+1)}</div><h3>${m.title}</h3><p>${m.desc}</p><div class="rjx-pillbar"><span class="rjx-visual-badge">${activityLabel(m.activity)}</span></div><span class="rjx-link">${isDone(kind,m.globalIndex)?'Review':'Open'} lesson →</span></div>`).join('')}</div>${pagination(pages,pg)}`;
 wireCrumbs(root); document.getElementById('v14AllSecs').onclick=()=>{V14.exam.section=null;V14.exam.page=0;renderExamCentre(root,sec)};root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14lesson]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{V14.exam.index=+x.dataset.v14lesson;renderExamCentre(root,sec);window.scrollTo(0,0)});root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14page]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{V14.exam.page=+x.dataset.v14page;renderExamCentre(root,sec);window.scrollTo(0,0)});
}
function pagination(pages,pg){if(pages<=1)return'';return `<div class="rjx-pagination">${Array.from({length:pages},(_,i)=>`<button class="${i===pg?'active':''}" data-v14page="${i}">${i+1}</button>`).join('')}</div>`}
function activityLabel(t){return ({photo:'📷 Picture description',mcq:'✓ Multiple choice',gap:'⌨️ Gap fill',match:'🔗 Matching',sort:'↕️ Sorting',error:'🔎 Find the error',paraphrase:'♻️ Paraphrasing',flash:'🃏 Flip cards',compare:'⚖️ Compare answers',type:'✍️ Type your answer',timer:'⏱️ Timed challenge'})[t]||'Interactive practice'}
function drawExamLesson(root,sec,kind,mods,idx,name){const m=mods[idx], section=examSections(kind).find(x=>x.key===m.section);const same=mods.map((x,i)=>({...x,globalIndex:i})).filter(x=>x.section===m.section);const pos=same.findIndex(x=>x.globalIndex===idx);const prev=idx>0?idx-1:null,next=idx<mods.length-1?idx+1:null;const progress=Math.round(((idx+1)/mods.length)*100);
 root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(name)+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><div><strong>${section.icon} ${section.name} · ${m.title}</strong><br><small>Lesson ${idx+1} of ${mods.length}</small></div><button class="rjx-btn" id="v14BackSection">← Back to ${section.name}</button></div><div class="rjx-mini-progress"><span style="width:${progress}%"></span></div><div class="rjx-activity-shell" style="margin-top:18px"><main class="rjx-activity-main"><div class="rjx-tag">${kind.toUpperCase()} · ${activityLabel(m.activity)}</div><h2>${m.title}</h2><p>${m.desc}</p>${lessonTeaching(kind,m,idx)}${buildActivity(kind,m,idx)}</main><aside class="rjx-activity-side"><h3>Lesson path</h3><div class="rjx-step-list"><div class="rjx-step"><strong>1. Learn</strong><span>Understand the exam skill.</span></div><div class="rjx-step"><strong>2. Notice</strong><span>Study the worked example.</span></div><div class="rjx-step"><strong>3. Practise</strong><span>Complete the interactive task.</span></div><div class="rjx-step"><strong>4. Review</strong><span>Check feedback and improve.</span></div></div><div class="rjx-scorebox" style="margin-top:14px"><strong>Progress</strong><div>${idx+1} / ${mods.length} lessons</div><div>${progress}% through the centre</div></div><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="v14Complete" style="width:100%;margin-top:14px">${next!==null?'Complete & next lesson →':'Complete final lesson ✓'}</button></aside></div><div class="rjx-bottom-nav">${prev!==null?'<button class="rjx-btn" id="v14Prev">← Previous lesson</button>':'<span></span>'}<span>Lesson ${idx+1} of ${mods.length}</span>${next!==null?'<button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="v14Next">Next lesson →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">FINAL LESSON ✓</span>'}</div>`;
 wireCrumbs(root);wireActivity(root,kind,m,idx);document.getElementById('v14BackSection').onclick=()=>{V14.exam.index=null;V14.exam.section=m.section;V14.exam.page=Math.floor(pos/10);renderExamCentre(root,sec)};if(prev!==null)document.getElementById('v14Prev').onclick=()=>{V14.exam.index=prev;renderExamCentre(root,sec);window.scrollTo(0,0)};if(next!==null)document.getElementById('v14Next').onclick=()=>{V14.exam.index=next;renderExamCentre(root,sec);window.scrollTo(0,0)};document.getElementById('v14Complete').onclick=()=>{markDone(doneKey(kind,idx));if(next!==null){V14.exam.index=next;renderExamCentre(root,sec);window.scrollTo(0,0)}else{V14.exam.index=null;V14.exam.section=null;renderExamCentre(root,sec);window.scrollTo(0,0)}};
}
function lessonTeaching(kind,m,idx){
 const strat=kind==='ielts'?ieltsStrategy(m.section,m.title):toeicStrategy(m.section,m.title);return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Learn the strategy</h4><p>${strat.teach}</p><div class="rjx-checklist">${strat.steps.map(x=>`<div class="rjx-check">✓ ${x}</div>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Worked example</h4><div class="rjx-task">${strat.example}</div></div>`
}
function ieltsStrategy(sec,title){const map={listening:{teach:'IELTS Listening rewards prediction, accurate detail and careful attention to distractors.',steps:['Read the instructions and word limit','Predict the type of answer','Listen for paraphrases, not exact repeats','Notice corrections and distractors','Check spelling and grammar'],example:'Prompt: The meeting starts at _____. Audio-style line: “It was originally planned for nine, but we have moved it to half past nine.” → 9:30.'},reading:{teach:'IELTS Reading is about locating evidence efficiently and distinguishing what the text says from what you assume.',steps:['Identify keywords and likely synonyms','Skim for paragraph purpose','Scan for evidence','Read around the answer location','Check whether the statement is supported, contradicted or absent'],example:'Text: “The museum opened in 1998 after a three-year renovation.” Statement: The renovation began in 1995. → TRUE.'},writing:{teach:'Higher IELTS Writing bands require clear task response, logical organisation, precise vocabulary and controlled grammar.',steps:['Analyse the exact task','Plan before writing','Use a clear overview or position','Develop each paragraph with evidence','Edit for grammar, repetition and cohesion'],example:'Weak: “The graph goes up a lot.” Stronger: “The figure rose sharply from 35% to just over 60% during the period.”'},speaking:{teach:'IELTS Speaking rewards natural, extended answers rather than memorised speeches.',steps:['Answer directly','Add a reason','Give a specific detail or example','Use flexible vocabulary naturally','Keep going without repeating yourself'],example:'Q: Do you enjoy cooking? A: Yes, especially at weekends, because it helps me unwind. Recently I have been learning a few Thai dishes, which has made it more interesting.'}};return map[sec]||map.reading}
function toeicStrategy(sec,title){const map={p1:{teach:'TOEIC Part 1 tests whether you can match a photograph with an accurate spoken description.',steps:['Look at people, objects and positions','Notice the main action','Watch prepositions carefully','Reject options that mention invisible objects','Choose what is clearly supported by the scene'],example:'Photo: a woman typing at a desk. Correct style: “She is working at a computer.” Distractor: “She is carrying a computer.”'},p2:{teach:'Part 2 is fast. Identify the question type first, then listen for a natural response rather than repeated words.',steps:['Identify WH / yes-no / request / choice','Expect indirect replies','Do not choose by keyword alone','Eliminate grammatically impossible replies','Choose the response that fits the situation'],example:'Q: “Where should I leave these boxes?” A: “Next to the loading door.”'},p3:{teach:'Part 3 conversations test purpose, detail, inference and next action in workplace situations.',steps:['Read the questions first','Identify who the speakers are','Track the problem or purpose','Listen for changes and next steps','Use tone and context for inference'],example:'“I can move your appointment to Thursday afternoon.” → The speakers are discussing a schedule change.'},p4:{teach:'Part 4 talks include announcements, messages and presentations. Focus on purpose, audience and key details.',steps:['Identify the type of talk','Listen for names, times and locations','Follow signposting words','Connect details to the question order','Infer the likely next action'],example:'“Passengers for Flight 218 should proceed to Gate 14.” → The announcement concerns boarding.'},p5:{teach:'Part 5 tests grammar and vocabulary in one sentence. Use structure before meaning when possible.',steps:['Identify the missing word type','Check verb tense and agreement','Look for collocations','Check connectors and prepositions','Read the complete sentence once more'],example:'The manager spoke ____ about the revised schedule. → clearly (adverb modifies spoke).'},p6:{teach:'Part 6 adds cohesion and context. The best answer must fit both the sentence and the whole text.',steps:['Identify text purpose and tone','Solve local grammar first','Check pronoun and connector references','Use surrounding sentences for vocabulary','Re-read the paragraph for cohesion'],example:'Email: “The meeting has been moved to Friday. _____, the room remains unchanged.” → However / Nevertheless depending on contrast.'},p7:{teach:'Part 7 is a reading-management test as well as a comprehension test.',steps:['Identify document type and purpose','Read questions before deep reading','Scan for names, dates and numbers','Use evidence for inference','Cross-reference multiple documents'],example:'Email + schedule: the email requests a morning slot; the schedule shows only 11:30 available → 11:30 is the likely answer.'}};return map[sec]||map.p5}
function buildActivity(kind,m,idx){if(m.activity==='photo')return photoActivity(idx); const t=m.activity; if(t==='mcq')return mcqActivity(kind,m,idx);if(t==='gap')return gapActivity(kind,m,idx);if(t==='match')return matchActivity(kind,m,idx);if(t==='sort')return sortActivity(kind,m,idx);if(t==='error')return errorActivity(kind,m,idx);if(t==='paraphrase')return paraphraseActivity(kind,m,idx);if(t==='flash')return flashActivity(kind,m,idx);if(t==='compare')return compareActivity(kind,m,idx);if(t==='type')return typeActivity(kind,m,idx);return timerActivity(kind,m,idx)}
function photoScene(i){const scenes=[['office','A woman is typing at a computer.'],['meeting','Several colleagues are seated around a conference table.'],['restaurant','A server is placing dishes on a table.'],['airport','Travellers are waiting near a departure gate.'],['train','Passengers are standing beside a train.'],['warehouse','Boxes are stacked on shelves in a warehouse.'],['factory','Workers are inspecting equipment on a production line.'],['construction','A worker is wearing a hard hat near a building site.'],['hotel','A guest is speaking with a receptionist.'],['street','A delivery van is parked beside the pavement.'],['park','People are sitting on benches near trees.'],['conference','A presenter is speaking in front of a screen.'],['classroom','Students are seated at desks facing a board.'],['reception','A receptionist is answering a telephone.'],['computer','Two employees are looking at the same monitor.'],['boxes','A man is carrying a box through a doorway.'],['phone','A woman is talking on a mobile phone.'],['waiting','Several people are seated in a waiting area.'],['delivery','A courier is unloading packages from a van.'],['shop','Clothing is displayed on racks in a shop.']];return scenes[i%scenes.length]}
function sceneSvg(type,i){const bg=['#dfe9f4','#e9edf2','#dbe8df','#eee5dc'][i%4]; const common=`<rect width="800" height="460" fill="${bg}"/><rect y="330" width="800" height="130" fill="#c8d1da"/><rect x="40" y="55" width="720" height="250" rx="18" fill="#f9fbfd" stroke="#94a5b8" stroke-width="4"/>`;let body='';
 const person=(x,y,shirt='#245ca6')=>`<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="25" fill="#d6a77c"/><rect x="${x-22}" y="${y+25}" width="44" height="78" rx="18" fill="${shirt}"/><line x1="${x}" y1="${y+100}" x2="${x-20}" y2="${y+145}" stroke="#263a52" stroke-width="12"/><line x1="${x}" y1="${y+100}" x2="${x+20}" y2="${y+145}" stroke="#263a52" stroke-width="12"/>`;
 if(['office','computer','phone','reception'].includes(type)){body=`<rect x="170" y="240" width="440" height="30" fill="#7c8a96"/><rect x="340" y="150" width="150" height="90" rx="8" fill="#25364a"/><rect x="355" y="165" width="120" height="60" fill="#87b9e8"/>${person(270,180)}${type==='computer'?person(560,180,'#8b4f95'):''}<rect x="205" y="260" width="40" height="80" fill="#566474"/><rect x="535" y="260" width="40" height="80" fill="#566474"/>`}
 else if(['meeting','conference','classroom','waiting'].includes(type)){body=`<rect x="160" y="245" width="480" height="34" rx="8" fill="#7b8794"/>${person(220,160)}${person(360,160,'#7c4f9c')}${person(500,160,'#418263')}${person(620,160,'#a85a54')}${type==='conference'?'<rect x="620" y="90" width="100" height="130" fill="#dce8f5" stroke="#66788a"/><line x1="670" y1="220" x2="670" y2="300" stroke="#66788a" stroke-width="8"/>':''}`}
 else if(['restaurant','hotel','shop'].includes(type)){body=`<rect x="120" y="230" width="240" height="35" fill="#8b6b4a"/><rect x="500" y="230" width="180" height="35" fill="#8b6b4a"/>${person(220,155)}${person(560,155,'#7a3f3f')}<rect x="140" y="100" width="120" height="70" fill="#f5d48b"/><rect x="520" y="105" width="130" height="65" fill="#d8e2ec"/>`}
 else if(['airport','train','street','delivery'].includes(type)){body=`<rect x="80" y="260" width="640" height="50" rx="20" fill="#4c6d89"/><circle cx="180" cy="320" r="30" fill="#26384a"/><circle cx="610" cy="320" r="30" fill="#26384a"/>${person(260,145)}${person(420,145,'#8f5e2d')}<rect x="110" y="95" width="180" height="80" fill="#cbe2f7" stroke="#58738c"/>`}
 else if(['warehouse','factory','construction','boxes'].includes(type)){body=`<rect x="95" y="105" width="170" height="180" fill="#7d8791"/><rect x="535" y="105" width="170" height="180" fill="#7d8791"/>${[0,1,2].map(r=>[0,1].map(c=>`<rect x="${120+c*75}" y="${130+r*50}" width="55" height="36" fill="#b98a54"/>`).join('')).join('')}${person(400,155,'#d99724')}<rect x="350" y="270" width="100" height="70" fill="#b98a54"/>`}
 else {body=`<circle cx="180" cy="150" r="70" fill="#72a85d"/><circle cx="650" cy="155" r="80" fill="#6b9e58"/><rect x="120" y="260" width="560" height="24" fill="#8a6b4f"/>${person(350,170)}${person(500,170,'#7d4f8c')}`}
 return `<svg viewBox="0 0 800 460" role="img" aria-label="Generated TOEIC workplace scene">${common}${body}<text x="55" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#41556d">TOEIC visual practice · generated scene ${i+1}</text></svg>`}
function photoActivity(idx){const [type,correct]=photoScene(idx), wrong=[correct.replace('is ','is not '),'Several vehicles are moving through the area.','The room is completely empty.'];const opts=[correct,...wrong].sort((a,b)=>((idx+a.length)%7)-((idx+b.length)%7));const ans=opts.indexOf(correct);return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><span class="rjx-visual-badge">📷 TOEIC Part 1 visual</span><h4>Look at the picture</h4><div class="rjx-toeic-photo">${sceneSvg(type,idx)}<div class="rjx-photo-caption">Study the people, actions, objects and positions before choosing.</div></div><p><strong>Which description best matches the picture?</strong></p><div class="rjx-options">${opts.map((o,i)=>`<button class="rjx-option" data-v14choice="${i}" data-answer="${ans}">${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}. ${o}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-explain" id="v14Explain"><strong>Explanation:</strong> ${correct} The other choices either contradict the visible action or mention information that is not supported by the scene.</div></div>`}
function mcqActivity(kind,m,idx){const q=kind==='ielts'?['Which approach best supports a high-band answer?',['Use evidence and precise language','Guess from one keyword','Ignore the task wording'],0]:['What should you do first?',['Identify the grammar or question type','Choose the longest answer','Match a repeated word only'],0];return choiceBox('Quick decision',q[0],q[1],q[2],'Use the strategy from the lesson rather than relying on surface keywords.')}
function paraphraseActivity(kind,m,idx){return choiceBox('Choose the best paraphrase','Which option keeps the original meaning?',kind==='ielts'?['The figure increased considerably.','The number became nice.','The graph did a big up.']:['The shipment has been postponed.','The shipment has been forgotten.','The shipment has already arrived.'],0,'A good paraphrase changes the wording while preserving the meaning.')}
function errorActivity(kind,m,idx){const bad=kind==='ielts'?'The number of visitors have increased sharply since 2022.':'Each of the reports are ready for review.';return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Find the error</h4><p class="rjx-task">${bad}</p><button class="rjx-btn" data-v14-reveal>Reveal correction</button><div class="rjx-explain" id="v14Explain"><strong>Correction:</strong> ${kind==='ielts'?'The number of visitors has increased sharply since 2022.':'Each of the reports is ready for review.'} The subject is singular, so the verb must agree.</div></div>`}
function gapActivity(kind,m,idx){const ans=kind==='ielts'?'significantly':'available';return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Complete the gap</h4><p>${kind==='ielts'?'Sales increased ______ between 2019 and 2021.':'The conference room is ______ after 2 p.m.'}</p><input class="rjx-inline-input" id="v14Text" placeholder="Type one word"><button class="rjx-btn primary" data-v14-checktext data-answer="${ans}" style="margin-top:10px">Check answer</button><div class="rjx-explain" id="v14Explain"><strong>Answer:</strong> ${ans}. Check both grammar and meaning.</div></div>`}
function matchActivity(kind,m,idx){const pairs=kind==='ielts'?[['sharp rise','large increase'],['remain stable','show little change'],['in contrast','introduce difference']]:[['reschedule','move to another time'],['invoice','request for payment'],['shipment','goods being delivered']];return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Match the pairs</h4><p>Click a term, then click its matching meaning.</p><div class="rjx-match-grid">${pairs.flatMap((p,i)=>[`<button class="rjx-match-item" data-pair="${i}" data-side="a">${p[0]}</button>`,`<button class="rjx-match-item" data-pair="${i}" data-side="b">${p[1]}</button>`]).sort((a,b)=>a.length-b.length).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-explain" id="v14Explain">Match all three pairs. Correct pairs turn green.</div></div>`}
function sortActivity(kind,m,idx){const arr=kind==='ielts'?['Analyse the task','Plan key ideas','Write the response','Check and edit']:['Read the question','Locate the evidence','Eliminate distractors','Choose and check'];return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Put the strategy in order</h4><p>Drag the steps into the best order.</p><div class="rjx-sort-list" id="v14Sort">${[...arr].reverse().map((x,i)=>`<div class="rjx-sort-item" draggable="true" data-order="${arr.indexOf(x)}">${x}</div>`).join('')}</div><button class="rjx-btn primary" data-v14-checksort style="margin-top:10px">Check order</button><div class="rjx-explain" id="v14Explain"><strong>Best order:</strong> ${arr.join(' → ')}</div></div>`}
function flashActivity(kind,m,idx){const cards=kind==='ielts'?[['substantial','large or important'],['fluctuate','rise and fall'],['coherent','logically organised']]:[['deadline','latest completion time'],['venue','place where an event happens'],['reimburse','pay someone back']];return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Vocabulary flip cards</h4><p>Tap each card to reveal the meaning.</p><div class="rjx-flips">${cards.map((c,i)=>`<div class="rjx-flip" data-front="${esc(c[0])}" data-back="${esc(c[1])}">${c[0]}</div>`).join('')}</div></div>`}
function compareActivity(kind,m,idx){return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>${kind==='ielts'?'Band-score comparison':'Strong vs weak response'}</h4><div class="rjx-band-compare"><div class="rjx-band-box weak"><strong>${kind==='ielts'?'Weaker':'Weak'}</strong><p>${kind==='ielts'?'There are many changes and it is very good.':'Yes, maybe.'}</p></div><div class="rjx-band-box strong"><strong>${kind==='ielts'?'Stronger':'Strong'}</strong><p>${kind==='ielts'?'Overall, the most notable change is the sharp rise in online sales, while store sales remain comparatively stable.':'Certainly. I can send the revised schedule before noon.'}</p></div></div><button class="rjx-btn" data-v14-reveal style="margin-top:12px">Why is the stronger answer better?</button><div class="rjx-explain" id="v14Explain">It is more precise, complete and appropriate to the task. It also uses natural vocabulary and clearer grammar.</div></div>`}
function typeActivity(kind,m,idx){return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Produce your own answer</h4><p>${kind==='ielts'?'Write 2–3 sentences using the strategy from this lesson.':'Write one natural workplace sentence using the target language.'}</p><textarea class="rjx-input" id="v14Draft" style="min-height:120px" placeholder="Type your answer here..."></textarea><button class="rjx-btn primary" data-v14-save style="margin-top:10px">Save answer</button><div class="rjx-explain" id="v14Explain">Saved. Compare your answer with the lesson strategy before moving on.</div></div>`}
function timerActivity(kind,m,idx){return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Timed challenge</h4><p>${kind==='ielts'?'Give yourself 60 seconds to plan or answer the task using clear structure.':'Answer as quickly and accurately as you can.'}</p><div class="rjx-timer" id="v14Timer">01:00</div><div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn primary" data-v14-starttimer>Start</button><button class="rjx-btn" data-v14-resettimer>Reset</button></div></div>`}
function choiceBox(title,q,opts,ans,exp){return `<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>${title}</h4><p><strong>${q}</strong></p><div class="rjx-options">${opts.map((o,i)=>`<button class="rjx-option" data-v14choice="${i}" data-answer="${ans}">${o}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-explain" id="v14Explain">${exp}</div></div>`}
function wireActivity(root,kind,m,idx){
 const exp=root.querySelector('#v14Explain');root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14choice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const ans=+b.dataset.answer,chosen=+b.dataset.v14choice;const opts=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14choice]')];opts.forEach((x,i)=>{x.disabled=true;if(i===ans)x.classList.add('correct')});if(chosen!==ans)b.classList.add('wrong');if(exp)exp.classList.add('show')});
 root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14-reveal]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>exp?.classList.add('show'));
 const checkText=root.querySelector('[data-v14-checktext]');if(checkText)checkText.onclick=()=>{const v=(root.querySelector('#v14Text')?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();const ans=checkText.dataset.answer.toLowerCase();checkText.textContent=v===ans?'✓ Correct':'Try again / show answer';if(v===ans||v.length>1)exp?.classList.add('show')};
 let selected=null;root.querySelectorAll('.rjx-match-item').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{if(x.classList.contains('done'))return;if(!selected){selected=x;x.classList.add('selected');return}if(selected.dataset.side!==x.dataset.side&&selected.dataset.pair===x.dataset.pair){selected.classList.remove('selected');selected.classList.add('done');x.classList.add('done');selected=null}else{selected.classList.remove('selected');selected=x;x.classList.add('selected')}});
 root.querySelectorAll('.rjx-flip').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{const r=!x.classList.contains('revealed');x.classList.toggle('revealed',r);x.textContent=r?x.dataset.back:x.dataset.front});
 const list=root.querySelector('#v14Sort');if(list){let drag=null;list.querySelectorAll('.rjx-sort-item').forEach(x=>{x.ondragstart=()=>{drag=x;x.classList.add('dragging')};x.ondragend=()=>x.classList.remove('dragging');x.ondragover=e=>{e.preventDefault();const after=[...list.querySelectorAll('.rjx-sort-item:not(.dragging)')].find(el=>e.clientY<=el.getBoundingClientRect().top+el.offsetHeight/2);if(after)list.insertBefore(drag,after);else list.appendChild(drag)}});root.querySelector('[data-v14-checksort]').onclick=()=>{const ok=[...list.children].every((x,i)=>+x.dataset.order===i);root.querySelector('[data-v14-checksort]').textContent=ok?'✓ Correct order':'Not yet — review the model order';exp?.classList.add('show')}}
 const save=root.querySelector('[data-v14-save]');if(save)save.onclick=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(`v14draft-${kind}-${idx}`,root.querySelector('#v14Draft').value)}catch(e){};save.textContent='✓ Saved';exp?.classList.add('show')};if(root.querySelector('#v14Draft')){try{root.querySelector('#v14Draft').value=localStorage.getItem(`v14draft-${kind}-${idx}`)||''}catch(e){}}
 let t=null;const timer=root.querySelector('#v14Timer');const set=n=>{if(timer)timer.textContent=`00:${String(n).padStart(2,'0')}`};const start=root.querySelector('[data-v14-starttimer]');if(start)start.onclick=()=>{clearInterval(t);let n=60;set(n);t=setInterval(()=>{n--;set(n);if(n<=0){clearInterval(t);timer.textContent='TIME'}},1000)};const reset=root.querySelector('[data-v14-resettimer]');if(reset)reset.onclick=()=>{clearInterval(t);set(60)};
}

function renderCueCards(root){V14.exam.kind='ielts'; const draw=()=>{const i=V14.cueIndex,c=CUES[i];root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('IELTS Cue Cards')+`<div class="rjx-exam-hero"><div class="rjx-tag" style="background:#fff;color:#07172f">IELTS SPEAKING PART 2</div><h2>Cue Card Practice Centre</h2><p>30 complete Cue Cards with preparation and speaking timers, Band 7–9 language, model answers and Part 3 follow-up questions.</p><div class="rjx-exam-stats"><span class="rjx-exam-stat">Card ${i+1} of ${CUES.length}</span><span class="rjx-exam-stat">1 min preparation</span><span class="rjx-exam-stat">2 min speaking</span></div></div><div class="rjx-cue-layout"><div class="rjx-cue-card"><div class="rjx-cue-top"><div class="rjx-tag" style="background:#fff;color:#07172f">CARD ${i+1}</div><h2>${c[0]}</h2><p>${c[1]}</p></div><div class="rjx-cue-body"><h3>You should say:</h3><div class="rjx-cue-bullets">${c[2].map(x=>`<div class="rjx-cue-bullet">• ${x}</div>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-timer-grid"><div class="rjx-timer-box"><strong>Preparation</strong><div class="rjx-timer" id="prepT">01:00</div><div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn primary" data-cuetimer="prep">Start</button><button class="rjx-btn" data-cuereset="prep">Reset</button></div></div><div class="rjx-timer-box"><strong>Speaking</strong><div class="rjx-timer" id="speakT">02:00</div><div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn primary" data-cuetimer="speak">Start</button><button class="rjx-btn" data-cuereset="speak">Reset</button></div></div></div></div></div><div><div class="rjx-resource-grid"><div class="rjx-resource"><h4>Band 7–9 vocabulary</h4>${c[3].map(x=>`<div class="rjx-check">${x}</div>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-resource"><h4>Linking phrases</h4>${c[4].map(x=>`<div class="rjx-check">${x}</div>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-resource"><h4>Idea bank</h4>${c[5].map(x=>`<div class="rjx-check">${x}</div>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-resource"><h4>Part 3 follow-up</h4>${c[7].map(x=>`<div class="rjx-check">${x}</div>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="rjx-resource" style="margin-top:12px"><h4>Model Band 7–9 answer</h4><button class="rjx-btn" id="showModel">Show model answer</button><div class="rjx-model-answer" id="modelAns" style="display:none;margin-top:10px">${c[6]}</div></div></div></div><div class="rjx-bottom-nav">${i>0?'<button class="rjx-btn" id="cuePrev">← Previous card</button>':'<span></span>'}<span>Card ${i+1} of ${CUES.length}</span>${i<CUES.length-1?'<button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="cueNext">Next Cue Card →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">FINAL CUE CARD ✓</span>'}</div><div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="rjx-btn" id="cueBack">← Back to IELTS Centre</button></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('showModel').onclick=()=>{const x=document.getElementById('modelAns');x.style.display=x.style.display==='none'?'block':'none'};let ti={prep:null,speak:null};function run(which,secs){clearInterval(ti[which]);let n=secs;const el=document.getElementById(which==='prep'?'prepT':'speakT');const paint=()=>el.textContent=`${String(Math.floor(n/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(n%60).padStart(2,'0')}`;paint();ti[which]=setInterval(()=>{n--;paint();if(n<=0){clearInterval(ti[which]);el.textContent='TIME'}},1000)}root.querySelectorAll('[data-cuetimer]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>run(b.dataset.cuetimer,b.dataset.cuetimer==='prep'?60:120));root.querySelectorAll('[data-cuereset]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const w=b.dataset.cuereset;clearInterval(ti[w]);document.getElementById(w==='prep'?'prepT':'speakT').textContent=w==='prep'?'01:00':'02:00'});if(i>0)document.getElementById('cuePrev').onclick=()=>{V14.cueIndex--;draw();window.scrollTo(0,0)};if(i<CUES.length-1)document.getElementById('cueNext').onclick=()=>{V14.cueIndex++;draw();window.scrollTo(0,0)};document.getElementById('cueBack').onclick=()=>{V14.exam={kind:'ielts',section:null,index:null,page:0};renderExamCentre(root,'ielts')}};draw()}

// Keep the legacy app's calls, but route IELTS/TOEIC and Cue Cards through the richer V14 engines.

// V15 TOEIC photo lab upgrade: realistic images + richer interactive picture description tasks.
const V15_TOEIC_PHOTOS = [{"title": "Coffee shop conversation", "img": "data:image/jpeg;base64,
